daemons.name: netd
daemons.detail: io.k3sm.netd is not loaded in the system domain

alert.cause: The network helper (netd) is not loaded in launchd, so nothing runs it and pods on this Mac lose their network and the node resolver is not maintained.
evidence: io.k3sm.netd is not loaded in the system domain

fix.step: Re-run the install, which is idempotent and puts back what is missing

daemons.name: server
daemons.detail: io.k3sm.server is disabled in the system domain
daemons.remedy:
sudo launchctl enable system/io.k3sm.server
sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/io.k3sm.server

wide.cp-binaries: unknown-staged (no kube.version marker; staged before markers existed), pinned v1.37.1
wide.label: io.k3sm.server

alert.cause: The control-plane daemon is disabled in launchd, so it does not run, not even at boot, and the cluster's control plane is not serving.
evidence: io.k3sm.server is disabled in the system domain
